scope: 19 frozen cohort land entries of peninsula 1811, retaining complete intervals into January 1812 for Tarifa and Valencia. Figueras surprise, field action and blockade are distinct frozen entries; siege/relief actions are not extra campaign credit.
policy: At most three preassigned families including Bodart; at most one targeted follow-up; main session only. Catalogue navigation before assignment did not read substantive new historical passages.

entries.assignment_note: All volumes, embedded documents and reprints remain within the author family. Original Portuguese and allied Spanish evidence may remain mediated where Oman is assigned; no extra family is implied.
